acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Guest host Emmanuel Dzotsi goes to a packed sports bar in Brooklyn for his favorite soccer team’s biggest game in years.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Connie Wang tells the story of a championship window she didn't realize she was in — until it was too late.
Connie is the author of the book Oh My Mother! We got the idea to do this story from Aaron Reiss.
acts.credits: By Connie Wang; Produced by Diane Wu
acts.title: Pregnant, Pause

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Seth Lind, our Operations Director, isn’t a crier. But he wants to connect with his emotions, so guest host Emmanuel Dzotsi sets up an unconventional experiment.
acts.credits: By Emmanuel Dzotsi and Seth Lind
acts.title: Cry Hard with a Vengeance

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Two college baseball teams with horrible losing streaks — a combined 141 games — are scheduled to play each other. One of them must finally win.
acts.title: Benched Expectations
